3340.title: Unbounded restart retries and non-atomic diagnostics
3340.rootCauseOneLine: Managed restart failures use an unlimited fixed-delay loop; diagnostics write directly to unique final files without retention or failed-write cleanup.

prReviews.verdict: Relevant existing fix; static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Addresses retry budgeting and diagnostic publication; PR code was not executed.

3340.proposedFix: Bound and back off retries; publish diagnostics atomically with retention and cleanup; preserve stderr evidence.
3340.caveats: 2026-09-30: actual supervisor and diagnostic writer verified twice after normal frozen installs and full builds. Bounded synthetic callbacks and injected write faults only; no real ENOSPC, child startup chain or systemd. Initial startup/stderr findings remain historical.
